notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Activate Words of Worship twice by paying {2}.
Attempt to draw a card, instead gaining 5 life due to Words of Worship.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers, causing you to pay {3} to gain 5 life due to Words of Worship and draw two cards.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers, holding priority, activate Cadaverous Bloom twice by exiling two cards from your hand, adding {4}.
Activate Words of Worship by paying {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {3} to gain 5 life due to Words of Worship and draw two cards.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may pay additional mana into Well of Lost Dreams to draw more cards, which can be exiled by Cadaverous Bloom for near-infinite black and/or green mana.
